app.name: RetinaAI
app.title: Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Screening in Rural India
app.disclaimer: AI-assisted screening and referral support tool. Not a replacement for a certified ophthalmologist.

landing.heroBadge: Explainable Retinal AI for Primary Care
landing.heroTitle: Early Vision Screening for Every Village
landing.heroSubtitle: Empowering frontline health workers and primary health centres with explainable deep learning to detect diabetic retinopathy before irreversible vision loss.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for Rural Primary Care Realities
landing.featuresSubtitle: End-to-end clinical workflow designed for low-bandwidth, high-impact community screening camps.
landing.feat1Desc: Multi-stage ensemble predicting DR grade across 5 international clinical severity classes.
landing.feat2Desc: Heatmap visual overlays highlight microaneurysms, exudates, and hemorrhages to foster clinical trust.
landing.feat3Desc: Clear referral window guidelines and exportable bilingual PDF reports for tertiary eye hospital handoffs.
landing.feat4Desc: Sync screening records seamlessly when field connectivity is restored.
